title: Yummy Tasty Briny Uruguayan None Bowl
description: A hearty, briny Uruguayan dish featuring cranberry juice and double-rise bread.
instructions: Cut the double-rise bread into 1-inch cubes and place in the earthenware bowl.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread, then sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
In a separate pan, cook the sliced merguez sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the thinly sliced red onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional minute.
Pour the cranberry juice into the pan, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the cooked sausage mixture to the bread, then pour the cranberry sauce over the top.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Bake the earthenware bowl in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
